scoring_justification: Checker recomputes δ_c, δ_a, Δ_conv from agent-provided reconstructed defect parameters and iterations, comparing to paper-derived thresholds.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds for δ_c, δ_a, Δ_conv derived from paper-reported iteration counts and known defect geometry.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper iterations: K*_IGA=106, K*_FGA=200 for σ=0.25 S/m; K*_IGA=165, K*_FGA=200 for σ=0.5 S/m, SNR=25 dB. True defect is square void crack side 0.2λ0 at origin.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed Δ_conv = (K_FGA - K_IGA)/K_FGA * 100. Tolerances per plan: δ_c ≤ 2%, δ_a ≤ 10%, Δ_conv ≥ gold−10pp.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Thresholds directly derived from explicit paper iteration numbers and well-defined public true defect geometry.

outputs.description: Reconstructed defect parameters and convergence statistics for the IGA and FGA methods under two host conditions, used to compute center location error, area error, and convergence improvement.

output_contract.notes: The hidden verifier will compare your reconstructed defect parameters to the true (hidden) defect parameters using the metrics δ_c, δ_a, and Δ_conv.

steps.description: Recompute δ_c, δ_a for IGA, and Δ_conv per scenario; compare to paper-derived thresholds. Each scenario that meets all thresholds adds 0.5 to the total score.
